title: ElevenLabs API for Developers: Streaming, Latency, Speech to Text
desc:
Level up from your first ElevenLabs API call. This episode covers the three text to speech endpoint types, streaming audio in Python, what the optional voice settings do, the four documented latency principles: Flash models, streaming, geographic proximity and voice choice, the regional TTFB table, then speech to text with scribe_v2 and forced alignment for word timestamps. All code comes from the official docs.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
